title: TennisMalaysia — About and history
scope: Official LTAM history: Malayan Lawn Tennis in 1921, first national inter-team tournament in 1923, LTAM formation/ITF affiliation in 1965, fifteen affiliates and National Tennis Academy opening in 2014.
limitations: Pre-1963 Malayan evidence primarily reflects the historical Malayan tennis system and is not assumed to represent all present Malaysia territory equally.
